title: Holding (DP stocks) upload (BOW front end, HOLDING_DPSTOCKS_UPLOAD)
purpose: The older stock upload: each client's demat quantity per security, without prices or haircuts; 6 fields. BOW takes user deposit and user stock files during market hours too (other files 17:30 to 08:00).

columns.name: Client ID
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The client's UCC

columns.name: BSE / NSE Symbol
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. NSE symbol; blank when the security has only a BSE code (as BOW's sample)

columns.name: Series
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. NSE series; blank with the symbol

columns.name: Quantity
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Holding quantity from the DP (sellable demat quantity)

columns.name: BSE Scrip  Code
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. BSE scrip code; blank when the BSE scrip file has none

linked: Live RMS → Front-office files → BOW uploads (holding DP stocks)
